text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is seeking authority to prohibit vehicles greater than two metres in width from travelling the lane south of Davenport Road, east of Perth Avenue. Prohibiting vehicles which have a width of two metres or more from travelling on the subject lane section would be beneficial in reducing the incidence of damage to the adjacent private property.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Prohibited vehicles over 2 metres in width from travelling on lane first south of Davenport Road, between Perth Avenue and lane west of Symington Avenue, north of Kingsley Avenue.
